faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ARI Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the Junior Research Fellow post at Agharkar Research Institute is 10th August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a First Class M.Sc. in Analytical/Biochemistry or M. Pharma, along with a valid GATE/GPAT/CSIR-NET or equivalent qualification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the ARI Junior Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 35 years. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 37,000, plus House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the ARI Junior Research Fellow vacancy?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the official ARI website on or before the last date of application.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the ARI Junior Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, there is an application fee of Rs. 100 for General and OBC category candidates. SC/ST and Women candidates are exempted from the fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Junior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selection process will primarily involve an Online Interview to assess the suitability of the candidates for the position.

faq.question: Q8. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is ADVT/RecT/RGSTC/11/SP-364(8)/2026-27.

faq.question: Q9. Does the institute offer any relaxation in age for specific categories?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation will be provided to OBC, SC, ST, and other eligible categories as per the Government of India regulations.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The position of Junior Research Fellow at Agharkar Research Institute is a contractual role.
